day_titles.4: Nusa Penida and on to Kuta

1: Arrival at Ngurah Rai Airport and private transfer to your hotel
Check in at your valley villa at Sayan
Rest of the day free by the pool
Optional: the Monkey Forest or the Ubud art market
2: Breakfast, then a day out in an open top vintage Volkswagen
The Bali swing and Tegenungan waterfall
Tirta Empul, the holy spring temple
The Tegalalang rice terraces on the way back
3: Breakfast, then a full day north to the lake country
The Handara gate and Ulun Danu Beratan temple
A hill waterfall in the afternoon
Sunset at Tanah Lot, the sea temple on the rocks
4: Early breakfast and check out, then on to Sanur harbour
Speedboat across to Nusa Penida for the west coast
the Paluang cliff viewpoint, then Kelingking beach and Broken Bay
Private transfer to your hotel near Kuta in the evening
5: Breakfast, then south to Melasti beach
Banana boat and jet ski at Tanjung Benoa
Uluwatu temple on the cliffs at sunset
Kecak fire dance in the temple amphitheatre afterwards
6: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Ngurah Rai Airport for your flight home

expert.name: Putu
expert.quote: The vintage car morning and the Kecak dance are what children remember. Parents remember the valley villa.
expert.tip: Nusa Penida is a long day for small children, so we book the first boat and keep the following morning free. Carry motion sickness tablets, the crossing can be choppy after eleven.

summary: Six days for a family with three nights in a valley villa above Sayan and two on the coast, taking in a vintage car day through central Bali, the Bedugul lakes, Tanah Lot, Nusa Penida and the Kecak dance at Uluwatu.
included: Included: 5 nights with daily breakfast; private airport and inter city transfers; central Bali tour in a vintage Volkswagen; full day Bedugul tour with Tanah Lot; Nusa Penida west coast tour; Melasti beach with water sports, Uluwatu and the Kecak dance.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Indonesia visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
